description: This file defines a REST API resource for managing reports within the Fineract infrastructure. It includes endpoints for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting reports, with appropriate security and serialization handling.

classes.name: ReportsApiResource
classes.description: A REST API resource providing endpoints to manage reports, including listing, fetching by ID, creating, updating, and deleting reports. Incorporates security, serialization, and external service integrations.

methods.name: retrieveReportList
methods.description: Fetches a list of all reports with optional query parameters for serialization.

methods.name: retrieveReport
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of a specific report by ID, including optional template data.

methods.name: retrieveOfficeTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template object containing default report data and allowed parameters for client UI building.

methods.name: createReport
methods.description: Creates a new report based on input JSON, logs the command, returns the processing result.

methods.name: updateReport
methods.description: Updates an existing report's details like useReport description, logs the command, returns the processing result.

methods.name: deleteReport
methods.description: Deletes a non-core report by ID, logs the command, returns the result.
